rareResources.name: Zero-Point Capacitor
rareResources.desc: Vacuum power source. Each capacitor increases population growth by 0.25 per hour.

rareResources.name: Antihydrogen Reservoir
rareResources.desc: Colony dispatch reserve. Stores 2000 units of each warp fuel so its network can operate without the Peregrine.

rareResources.name: Sentinel Battery
rareResources.desc: Superconducting fire-control mount for census probes. Holds 40 rounds and reduces the firing interval.

rareResources.name: Closed Ecology Column
rareResources.desc: Recycles air, water and waste for 1000 people. Food still requires local production or supply ships.

rareResources.name: Ectogenesis Bank
rareResources.desc: Produces people from stored genetic lines. One bank is consumed at founding and at each population tier.
